A '''Beam Emitter''' was a component used on weapons such as the [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer]] and various [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] models. The emitter was the tip of the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], and extended out from the front of the weapon. On the paddle beamer, it was ahead of the [[Ion Focusing Coil]]s and [[Discharge Nozzle]]s and fired the weapon's [[ion beam]]. On disruptor weapons, it was located just ahead of the [[Acceleration Coil]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
